title: Cheapest Gyms New Plymouth
meta_desc: Find the most affordable gyms in New Plymouth with no contract options, including prices and discounts, plus information on Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme
intro: New Plymouth has a thriving fitness community, with a range of gyms to suit different budgets and preferences. For those on a tight budget, Contours and Snap Fitness offer affordable options with no contract required. Additionally, Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme provides discounts of 40-70% off for eligible members.

sections.heading: No-Contract Gym Options
sections.body: Contours is the cheapest option in New Plymouth, with a no-contract policy that allows members to cancel at any time. Snap Fitness also offers a flexible membership plan with no lock-in contract. Both gyms provide a range of equipment and classes, making them great options for those who want to try out a gym without committing to a long-term contract.
list: Snap Fitness: 6 weeks free, flexible membership

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: The subsidy can be used at a range of gyms in New Plymouth, including Contours and Snap Fitness. It's a great way to get started with exercise and improve overall health and wellbeing.

sections.heading: Conclusion
